scope: Recomputation from existing run_metrics; no simulations rerun; no TeX changes
method: Mean, sample SD (ddof=1), SE=SD/sqrt(n), CI=mean +/- t_(.975,n-1)*SE; intervals not clipped

comparison_tolerance.rationale: Allows 12-significant-digit serialization in the official summary; far below displayed precision

units.O_final: percentage of all accounts distinctly wronged by step 50
units.PR_final: percentage; average of defined run-level ratios
units.cumulative_reviews: cumulative review events, including repeat reviews; figure divided by 1000
units.clean_review_exposure: cumulative review events on clean accounts = FP+TN; figure divided by 1000
